lines.text: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, writes to chosen exiles in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.
By His great mercy, God has given new birth into a living hope through the baptism of Jesus Christ from the dead.
The inheritance is imperishable, undefiled, and unfading, reserved in heaven, and believers are shielded by God's power through faith.
Their proven faith, more precious than silver, may result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
The prophets searched carefully and were told they were serving not themselves but you, and angels long to look into these things.
